summary: INV-05 Pending invitations list: implemented GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations allowing Workspace Owner and Project Managers to view project invitations while rejecting members and viewers with 403 FORBIDDEN and outsiders with 404 NOT_FOUND. Automatically computes and maps past-due pending invitations to expired status, never leaks raw token or token_hash, and validates responses against shared invitationListResponseSchema. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Cursor-based deep pagination will be extended when large enterprise invitation volumes demand cursor offsets.
